headline: Strategic Line Freezes Across Map as Heavy Attrition Mounts in Stonecradle
war_summary: Territorial turnover has ground to an abrupt standstill across all fronts over the past two hours, with zero strategic base exchanges reported theatre-wide following earlier convulsions. The maritime sectors in Godcrofts and Fishermans Row have fallen nearly silent under complete Colonial occupation after fierce earlier clashes, while Linn of Mercy has similarly quieted with all eleven strongholds locked under Colonial colours. Further north, the Colonials secured a foothold in Mooring County at The Wind Hills before movement froze. Despite the pause in base captures, ferocious attrition continues along the central and northern axes. Stonecradle has become an intensifying cauldron, logging accelerating casualty and enlistment rates that claimed over a thousand men in two hours amidst Wardens fighting to hold their remaining three bastions. Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse likewise endure heavy slaughter, combining for nearly twenty-nine hundred casualties in the same span as artillery and infantry hammer static positions. While the frontlines show no immediate movement, mounting losses indicate fierce pressure ready to break the momentary deadlock.
